Reality tears open in an eternal warp-maelstrom as Lord Malgakor ascends into a literal Chaos God-Champion with 12,500 HP, surrounded by a legion of weeping plague-engines, daemonic ward-totems, and shrieking brass monoliths.

active_disasters_and_trials.name: The Cataclysm of the Chaos God-Lord

active_disasters_and_trials.human_trial: Sustain a full-scale protracted planetary siege: crack multiple defensive warding ziggurats, deploy macro-artillery and archeotech plasma batteries, and bleed the God-Lord down phase by phase.
